source_evidence: For accepted orders the warehouse picks the parts, packs the order and books a carrier.
problem: The warehouse department is classified as an automated system rather than a human organisational performer.
correction: Change Lane_warehouse laneMeta authority from "authority" to "sovereignty".

source_evidence:
The warehouse also does quality inspection and labelling for each order, but nobody could
say whether those happen before or after packing, or in which order relative to each other.

map_evidence.quote: <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pick-parts--quality-inspection" sourceRef="pick-parts" targetRef="quality-inspection" /><bpmn:sequenceFlow id="quality-inspection--pack-order" sourceRef="quality-inspection" targetRef="pack-order" />

problem: The map fixes quality inspection between picking and packing even though the source explicitly leaves its order unknown.
correction: Remove both sequence flows through quality-inspection and their incoming/outgoing references, connect pick-parts directly to pack-order, and leave quality-inspection unconnected with an associated note declaring its unknown order relative to packing and labelling.

map_evidence.quote: <bpmn:task id="send-payment-reminder" name="Send payment reminder"><bpmn:documentation>source: "The ERP sends a payment reminder after seven days."</bpmn:documentation>

problem: The map adds an ERP payment-reminder step supported by a fabricated source quotation.
correction: Remove send-payment-reminder, its lane reference and incident sequence flows and references, and connect generate-and-send-invoice directly to accepted-order-fulfilled.
